intro: Following pages are infosheets and some calculators (WIP) for the stamina based events, these event dont include the gacha events since i dont find them real megas and they do not include World Tree cup and Inferno Rally since their point gain is dependent on luck/ the floor you are on. I also did not include Sandtopia for similair reasons and Northern Oddyssey due to it not really needing planning, you will get Sunna with enough runs for sure.

You will see i have written out some ways of obtaining the URs (this is in all the megas 100 shards), I do not reccomend following certain scenarios (for all players, do not follow the no packs bought way, always buy 188 pack, and for people without a couple 100ks of gems, dont buy the largest packs as well, they have the worst gem value)

All math in the ways that i have done (not the calculators) is lazy math, this means i expect you to get to the 6 shard milestone or its equivalent with just stamina regen, this is in all the mega events possible if you do not let the stamina cap. Usually though you will go over the 6 shard milestone, so you can save some items when you are pushing, the amount of items you need that i wrote in here is for the worst case possible (aka no stamina rebate chance and barely making 6 shard milestone)

The calculators (WIP) are done with values you provide and should pose a relativily true answer to how many more items you need, the bigger push, the more true they become, luck is still a factor in here
I am currently in process of updating the sheet so some things arent finished rn
